evidence_text: Hitman Go is a turn-based puzzle video game developed by Square Enix Montreal and published by Square Enix . The player guides Agent 47 , protagonist of the Hitman franchise , through a series of grid-based levels . The Japanese title of the film begins with the character 新 , shin -LRB- new -RRB- , to distinguish this movie from a 1989 film -LRB- Lonely or Sad Hitman -RRB- , also based on a novel by Yamanouchi but unrelated in plot . Hitman City is a 2003 action-adventure movie that was directed by Scott Shaw . Following its announcement , Hitman Go was met with some scepticism from critics .
